name: ref-privesc
description: Account created, enabled or changed; password reset; added to a privileged group; user right or system security access granted.

criteria.query:
SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventID in (4704, 4717, 4720, 4722, 4724, 4728, 4732, 4735, 4738, 4756) | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor=SubjectUserName, TargetAccount=TargetUserName, Member=MemberName
| where not(Actor endswith "$" and (EventID == 4717 or (TargetAccount == "WsiAccount" and EventID in (4722, 4724, 4738)) or (TargetAccount == "la-admin" and EventID in (4724, 4738))))   // RA-027 12 Oct: Web Sign-in account, LAPS rotation, policy user rights
